sidebar.workspaceNoteBody: Keep alerts, reports, and plan progress aligned before every site review.

shell.supportBody: Keep camera health, alert response, and progress reporting aligned before each review cycle.

overview.heroDescription: Monitor delivery confidence, plan coverage, and recent alert pressure from one view before diving into detailed analysis.
overview.noMetrics: No metrics data available yet. Run the analysis engine first.
overview.reviewAlertsDescription: Review the queue to confirm which delays need action first.
overview.last12Weeks: Rolling view of the latest 12 weeks of site signals.
overview.activityChartDescription: Weekly movement intensity across the same 12-week window.
overview.summaryProgress: Progress delta of {{value}}% is within the expected range for this construction phase.
overview.summaryActivity: Activity index at {{value}} indicates normal on-site activity levels.
overview.summaryActiveHours: {{hours}}h of active work logged across {{count}} camera zones in the last 7 days.
overview.operationsDescription: Use this summary to decide whether the team should shift into alerts, plan tracking, or image review next.
overview.latestDailyBriefingDescription: The most recent operational narrative for the latest observed day.
overview.latestWeeklyInsightDescription: Narrative context for the latest weekly progress signal.
overview.noNarrativeDescription: Daily and weekly AI reports will appear here once reports are generated for this project.
overview.recentFlagsDescription: Latest issues surfaced from schedule, safety, anomaly, and weather checks.
overview.noRecentFlags: No recent flags for this project.

alertsPage.title: Alerts
alertsPage.description: Prioritize construction risks, review response history, and keep teams aligned on the alerts that need action first.
alertsPage.filterDescription: Refine the alert stream by signal type, severity, and response status.
alertsPage.emptyTitle: No alerts match the current filters.
alertsPage.emptyDescription: Try broadening the filters to review the wider alert history.

planPage.title: Construction plan
planPage.description: Upload current planning documents, compare milestone expectations against observed site progress, and catch delays early.
planPage.uploadDescription: Drag a PDF into the drop zone or browse from disk. Uploaded plans are parsed for milestone tracking.
planPage.uploadingDescription: This can take a few moments for larger documents.
planPage.dropDescription: Or browse files manually to upload the latest construction plan.
planPage.noMilestonesDescription: Upload a plan to generate milestone tracking and progress checks.

progressPage.title: Progress analytics
progressPage.description: Review progress velocity, activity intensity, and current delivery risk across the latest construction windows.
progressPage.weeklyDescription: Track how much visible structural progress is being observed each week.
progressPage.currentReadoutDescription: The latest weekly signal translated into operational guidance.
progressPage.comparedAgainst: Compared against {{count}} weeks of historical movement.
progressPage.activityIndexDescription: Use this to spot under-utilization or surges in movement.
progressPage.activeHoursDescription: Observed work window over the most recent seven-day period.
progressPage.howMetricReadDescription: Progress delta reflects visible structural change across weekly snapshots, not cost burn or labor hours.
progressPage.metricReadBody1: The chart is strongest when used alongside timelines and before/after review. High activity with low delta usually signals staging, prep, or weather disruption rather than finished work.
progressPage.metricReadBody2: Sustained low deltas paired with elevated risk levels are a strong indicator that the plan page should be reviewed for delayed milestones.

comparePage.noSnapshotsDescription: Run the image sync first to unlock before and after comparison.
comparePage.controlsDescription: Select two capture dates and drag the divider to inspect visible changes.
comparePage.visualDescription: Touch, drag, or use the slider above to inspect the two snapshots.
comparePage.metricChangesDescription: Data readout aligned to the two selected snapshots.

timelinePage.title: Site timeline
timelinePage.description: Scrub through the capture history, isolate a specific week, and compare the latest image sequence without relying on hover-only controls.
timelinePage.scrubbingHint: Use the week and date dropdowns or the range slider to move through the image sequence.
timelinePage.empty: No snapshots available yet. Run a sync and detection first.

reportsPage.title: AI Reports
reportsPage.description: Review recurring AI briefings and create custom analyses for specific time windows.
reportsPage.generateDescription: Create an ad hoc AI summary for a selected date range. Scheduled daily and weekly reports appear below as separate history sections.
reportsPage.analyzing: Analyzing site photos with GPT-4o Vision. This may take 30-60 seconds...
reportsPage.noReportsDescription: Daily briefings, weekly summaries, and custom analyses will appear here once generated.
reportsPage.evidenceSectionDescription: Open the exact images used as evidence for this report.
reportsPage.lowConfidenceDescription: This report is based on limited visual evidence for the selected period.
reportsPage.emptyTitle: Select a report from the sidebar, or generate a new one.
reportsPage.emptyDescription: AI reports analyze site photos and metrics to assess construction progress.

daily.title: Daily Briefings
daily.description: Operational day-level summaries for site leads and coordinators.

weekly.title: Weekly Summaries
weekly.description: Trend-based weekly narratives for project coordination and review.

custom.title: Custom Analyses
custom.description: Manual date-range summaries created for ad hoc investigation.

settingsPage.title: Settings
settingsPage.notificationHelp: Alert notifications will be sent to this email address when new flags are detected.
